_noteP: P (Living Battery) investigated (loop 357) -- genuinely NOT curatable as a simple hit, documented rather than force-fit. Wiki: charge builds via movement+Q casts (max 100); UNCHARGED attacks apply magic on-hit damage AND can flat-HP-execute targets below a threshold (BIN PassiveExecuteThreshold = ByCharLevelInterpolation(70->160) + 0.2 AP, stored oddly inside ZeriQAbility/ZeriQ, not the passive spell object); at MAX charge the next attack instead deals %maxHP magic damage (BIN PassiveMaxDamage = ByCharLevelInterpolation(75->160) + 1.1 AP, PassiveMaxChargePercentHealth = 0.01->0.11 fraction of max HP) with NO execute-threshold gate. This is a genuine two-state conditional (uncharged-with-flat-execute vs max-charge-with-%HP, mutually exclusive, gated on a charge meter this pipeline does not track live) plus an execute mechanic (kills outright below a threshold rather than dealing finite damage) that this schema has no representation for. No P block added -- same honest-gap class as Draven R falloff / Sona Melody / Vayne W DamageFloor. ZeriPassiveAbility itself only carries PassiveAttackSpeed (an AS steroid, unrelated to the above).
